# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

The cassocial project welcomes participation from people with varied backgrounds and experience. We expect everyone to help keep the community respectful and constructive.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate and respectful.
- Discuss ideas and work, not personal characteristics.
- Accept constructive feedback and differing views.
- Respect privacy and do not publish another person's private information.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, deliberate disruption, and publication of private information without consent are not acceptable.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may edit or remove contributions and may temporarily or permanently restrict participation for behavior that violates this policy. Report conduct concerns privately to the repository maintainers through GitHub's contact or reporting features.
